timing_disclosure: Two baseline fits have completed and their validation progress has been reported; neither root nor this plan uses intervention or heldout results. This is not a claim of before-training preregistration.
primary_unit: outer seed. Four seed-budget state means average the two paired training replicates; eight paired fits are not independent experiments.
row_metric: original fixed-L333-scale validation combined NRMSE; paired delta interaction minus baseline; lower is better
mechanism_metric: H sample-volume pair absolute difference error: within component mean then molecule mean; endpoint balanced normalized MAE Q=0.5*(MAE_deltaV1/s1 + MAE_deltaV2/s2). Also report all raw mL values, sign, amplitude and PE/EA controls.

descriptive_stable_support_rule.row: Both outer seeds improve after averaging budgets/replicates; >=3 of4 state means improve; no state relative NRMSE regression >1%
descriptive_stable_support_rule.condition: Both outer seeds improve Q; >=3 of4 state means improve Q

failure_interpretation: If either rule fails, no stable joint support for this one fusion control; do not search another architecture. Does not reject all H3 mechanisms or identify irreducible noise.
